Qatar's Former Emir Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani Dies at 74

Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani, the former emir of Qatar and credited as the architect of its modern development, has died at the age of 74. His passing was announced by Qatar's Amiri Diwan, the top government body. He oversaw significant growth and ambition for the gas-rich nation during his rule.
